issuing_body: Children and Families Agency (こども家庭庁)
implementation_notes: Issued by Japan's Children and Families Agency (Version 1.0.0, March 31, 2025) based on municipal and childcare demonstration projects. The handbook explicitly states it carries no legal or binding force and is intended as flexible reference guidance rather than uniform regulation. It covers text, image, and audio generative AI (excluding video generation) across a three-phase lifecycle (planning, preparation, and operation/evaluation), advising alignment with existing laws and government policies including the Personal Information Protection Act, Copyright Act, portrait/publicity rights, MIC local government information security guidelines, and the Digital Agency's generative AI usage agreement. Detailed use cases are published in a separate companion volume (事例編).
